contract.task_clause:
Which of the following best describes the fallacy of figure of speech?
Option A: Using emotionally charged language to create an impression about the subject of a claim, without making an argument that the language fits the subject.
Option B: Treating something that exists in the mind as if it was a real object.
Option C: Confusing figurative language with literal language.
Option D: A form of loaded language that uses an emotionally charged restatement of the claim in place of support for the claim.
